title: ArtShape
description: A geometry contract for an art asset: how it is constructed, what its topology is, and what it costs at each LOD tier. Declaring a shape is not a claim that the mesh exists or has been authored — it is a claim about what the mesh must satisfy if it does.

origin2d.description: The 2D construction this 3D shape derives from. Recording it makes the build reproducible by hand.

topology.description: The checkable properties. Everything a validator is allowed to reason about lives here as a value, never as prose.

quadPct.description: Percentage of faces that are quads. Deforming meshes need quad loops; triangles pinch.

capStyle.description: How the ends are closed. fan_tri concentrates a pole at the cap centre.

hasPoles.description: Derived from poleNote at authoring time so rules never parse prose.

poleNote.description: Human-readable detail. No rule may depend on this string.

deformsWithRig.description: Whether this shape is skinned and deformed. Flips several rules from advisory to blocking.

lod.description: Ordered LOD tiers, coarsest last. Triangle counts must be non-increasing.

annotations.description: Authored craft knowledge. `pitfall` is the scarce artifact — the tacit rule someone had to know. A hazardous shape is required to carry one.
